summary: The commit adds useful assertions and a structured claim registry, but two Stata missing-value traps can still contaminate newly registered results. Most importantly, define agreement and age eligibility with explicit nonmissing conditions before treating the generated numbers as reproducible; the package also remains an analysis rerun for one machine rather than an end-to-end replication archive.

findings.title: Blank-to-blank name fields are counted as transcription agreement
findings.what_the_code_does: The analysis constructs `congruent=namefrst==fs_namefrst & namelast==fs_namelast` without requiring either source to be nonblank, then constructs the target sample as `!(namefrst==fs_namefrst & namelast==fs_namelast)`. Stata therefore treats corresponding empty strings as agreements. The newly added model-agreement audit explicitly documents that blank-to-blank comparisons occur in these data, but the main congruence construction remains unguarded.
findings.why_it_matters: Records with jointly blank fields can inflate agreement, reduce the discordant target sample, and affect legibility, linkage-rate, subgroup, and sample-size results subsequently written to the replication registry. The exact numerical effect depends on the unseen data.
findings.how_to_check: Immediately after loading and renaming the name fields, run `count if congruent==1 & (namefrst=="" | fs_namefrst=="" | namelast=="" | fs_namelast=="")`, then compare all headline results after defining congruence only over the intended nonblank universe.
findings.suggested_fix: Define and document the eligible comparison universe first, require the relevant human fields to be nonempty, and set congruence missing outside that universe rather than classifying blank pairs as agreement. Apply the same definition consistently to `target`, district legibility, and downstream summaries.

findings.title: The age cutoff retains observations with missing age
findings.what_the_code_does: The sample restrictions use `keep if age>=10 & female==0` and `keep if sex==1 & age>=10`. Because numeric missing values exceed finite numbers in Stata, `age>=10` includes observations with `age==.` even though the stated sample is people aged 10 or older.
findings.why_it_matters: If age is missing for any eligible-sex records, the registered population and analysis counts, table means, disagreement shares, linkage rates, and heterogeneity results use the wrong sample. The repository itself records this as an unresolved hazard, but the new replication outputs still encode the affected results.
findings.how_to_check: Before each `keep`, run `count if missing(age) & female==0` or `count if missing(age) & sex==1`; then compare `_N` and the registered results under `age>=10 & age<.`.
findings.suggested_fix: Use `age>=10 & age<.` or `age>=10 & !missing(age)` in both sample constructions, document the number excluded, and regenerate every downstream result and exhibit.

findings.title: The replication package cannot rebuild its inputs and only runs on one hardcoded machine
findings.what_the_code_does: `config.do` accepts only hostname `ARTS-ECON-CM` and assigns absolute `D:`/`F:` paths; every other host exits with code 198. The master explicitly starts from frozen intermediates, while the README states that the ML pipeline is absent, the build tier cannot run, the linkage-producing project is outside the repository, Machine B has no runner, and frozen inputs lack checksums.
findings.why_it_matters: An external replicator cannot reproduce the analysis from raw inputs or establish that the machine-specific intermediate files are the versions that generated the committed results. This is a substantive replication break even though the limitations are candidly documented.
findings.how_to_check: On any machine other than `ARTS-ECON-CM`, run `Stata /b do replication/run_machineA.do`; configuration stops before analysis. Independently enumerate every `use` input in the master and confirm that no runnable in-repository path creates the frozen census, linkage, or model-output files.
findings.suggested_fix: Parameterize repository, data, paper, and executable paths through a user-supplied configuration; add or package the raw-to-intermediate and Machine-B runners; and record provenance plus SHA-256 checksums for every frozen input when redistribution is impossible.

verified_clean.item: The human-complete model-agreement categories explicitly avoid blank model matches and are asserted to partition the denominator.
verified_clean.evidence: The denominator and four mutually exclusive categories are defined at CODE/compute_model_agreement_on_discordant.do:116-137, with an exact partition assertion at CODE/compute_model_agreement_on_discordant.do:139-144.

verified_clean.item: Partial state aggregation is prevented from being reported as a complete model-agreement result.
verified_clean.evidence: The script counts successful states and aborts without writing totals unless all expected states contributed at CODE/compute_model_agreement_on_discordant.do:155-165.

verified_clean.item: The balance-table congruent and incongruent groups are checked to exhaust the defined analysis sample.
verified_clean.evidence: Counts are constructed at CODE/make_balance_exhibits.do:58-67 and checked with a terminating partition assertion at CODE/make_balance_exhibits.do:74-80.

verified_clean.item: The result writer rejects missing scalar results rather than emitting a silent `.` into LaTeX.
verified_clean.evidence: `repnum` tests `missing()` and exits before writing at replication/stata/repnum.ado:54-58.

verified_clean.item: The master preflights its declared frozen inputs and aborts before running if any are absent.
verified_clean.evidence: The input list and file-existence loop are at replication/run_machineA.do:39-65.

verified_clean.item: Randomness in the modified figure-producing script is seeded.
Claim mismatches, assertion failures, missing text, registry errors, and evaluation errors produce a nonzero checker result.
verified_clean.evidence: Failure classes are totaled and returned as exit status 1 at replication/check_claims.py:269-281.

review_limits: The census, linkage, and transcription data are external to the repository, so the magnitude of the blank-name and missing-age effects could not be measured.
The Stata pipeline was not executed; runtime conclusions are based on source inspection and committed generated artifacts.
No paper draft was supplied for this review. Claims-vs-code was not reviewed, and claim language visible only in the committed registry/report was not treated as an independently supplied draft.
The review was limited to `HEAD~1..HEAD`; unchanged code was followed only where needed to understand the modified replication outputs.
Identification was not an active dimension for this run.
